items.prompt:
Breaking a bond ____ energy.
A) absorbs
B) releases
C) destroys
D) creates

Forming a bond ____ energy.
A) absorbs
B) releases
C) hides
D) ignores

A reaction that releases energy overall is
A) exothermic
B) endothermic
C) neutral
D) frozen

If forming bonds releases more energy than breaking absorbed, the reaction is
A) exothermic
B) endothermic
C) impossible
D) always cold

A reaction that feels cold because it takes in heat is
A) exothermic
B) endothermic
C) neutral
D) burning

The net energy change of a reaction depends on
A) the change in total bond energy
B) the color of the chemicals
C) the price
D) the container shape
items.answer: A) the change in total bond energy

steps: Net energy depends on bonds broken vs formed.

items.prompt:
Burning fuel is exothermic because
A) forming the product bonds releases more energy than breaking the fuel bonds absorbed
B) it absorbs more than it releases
C) no bonds change
D) it only breaks bonds
items.answer: A) forming the product bonds releases more energy than breaking the fuel bonds absorbed

items.prompt:
An endothermic reaction overall
A) absorbs energy because breaking bonds takes more than forming releases
B) releases energy
C) changes no bonds
D) gives off heat
items.answer: A) absorbs energy because breaking bonds takes more than forming releases
